title: Best Game Controller (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were taken from the PC Gamer and IGN reviews, with preference for items mentioned by more than one source.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a PC gamer who wants a controller with mechanical buttons and adjustable Hall‑Effect thumbsticks. The Vader 5 Pro delivers that and a long‑lasting battery, making it ideal for long sessions. Its only drawback is that it lacks a symmetrical stick layout, which some players prefer.
